title: CANFAR · Platform Overview
description: Demand, GPU and efficiency for the CANFAR Science Platform. Operational health and node OOM kills live on Platform Health.

list.name: datasource
list.label: Data source
list.description: Metrics backend the panels query. Seeded at install time from grafanaDashboards.datasourceName; any other Prometheus-type datasource stays selectable here.

list.name: namespace
list.label: Namespace
list.description: Namespace holding CANFAR session workloads. Set at install time from the chart's resolved workload namespace.

list.name: community
list.label: Community
list.description: CANFAR `canfar.net/community` pod label. Kueue ClusterQueue / fair-share grouping dimension. Defaults to `default` when a session supplies none.

list.name: project
list.label: Project
list.description: CANFAR `canfar.net/project` pod label. Kueue LocalQueue dimension. Defaults to `default` when a session supplies none.

list.name: flavor
list.label: Flavor
list.description: `fixed` when the memory request equals the limit, otherwise `flexible`.

list.name: accelerator
list.label: Accelerator
list.description: `gpu` when the session requested GPUs, otherwise `none`. Exact GPU count comes from the nvidia.com/gpu resource request, not from this label.

panels.title: Active sessions
panels.description: Running CANFAR session pods matching the current filters.

panels.title: Active users
panels.description: Distinct users with at least one running session.

panels.title: Pending sessions
panels.description: Sessions accepted but not yet running: unscheduled, queued, or pulling an image.

panels.title: Queue backlog
panels.description: Workloads Kueue is holding before admission, across all ClusterQueues.

panels.title: CPU committed
panels.description: Fraction of allocatable cores already promised to pod requests.

panels.title: RAM committed
panels.description: Fraction of allocatable memory already promised to pod requests.

panels.title: Active sessions by kind
panels.description: Running sessions split by session type.

panels.title: Session CPU: requested vs used
panels.description: Aggregate CPU held by running sessions against what they actually burn.

panels.title: Top sessions by user
panels.description: The 15 users with the most running sessions. Project and community attribution arrive with the canfar.net/* label realignment.

panels.title: Session memory: requested vs used
panels.description: Aggregate memory held by running sessions against working-set usage.

panels.title: GPUs allocatable
panels.description: Total GPUs the scheduler can hand out across the cluster.

panels.title: GPUs requested
panels.description: GPUs held by running CANFAR sessions. These are GPUs *requested*, not GPU utilisation — a held GPU may be completely idle. Measuring real GPU usage needs a DCGM exporter, which is not deployed.

panels.title: GPU allocation
panels.description: Share of cluster GPUs held by running sessions. These are GPUs *requested*, not GPU utilisation — a held GPU may be completely idle. Measuring real GPU usage needs a DCGM exporter, which is not deployed.

panels.title: GPUs requested by session kind
panels.description: Which workload types are holding the GPUs. These are GPUs *requested*, not GPU utilisation — a held GPU may be completely idle. Measuring real GPU usage needs a DCGM exporter, which is not deployed.

panels.title: GPUs requested by user
panels.description: Top 10 users by GPUs held. These are GPUs *requested*, not GPU utilisation — a held GPU may be completely idle. Measuring real GPU usage needs a DCGM exporter, which is not deployed.

panels.title: CPU efficiency
panels.description: Used ÷ requested CPU across all running sessions. Above 100% the session is bursting beyond what it reserved. The per-kind breakdown behind this number lives on Efficiency & Waste.

panels.title: RAM efficiency
panels.description: Working set ÷ requested memory across all running sessions. Above 100% the session is bursting beyond what it reserved. The per-kind breakdown behind this number lives on Efficiency & Waste.
